podcast.title: Award-Winning Folk Artist
podcast.body: Currently, Julian Taylor is primarily known as a Roots performer and has received awards for his folk music. "These days he's best known as a Roots performer and someone who wins awards for his folk music."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Canadian Singer-Songwriter
podcast.body: Julian Taylor is a singer and songwriter from Toronto, Canada, who has been active in music for over two decades. "Julian Taylor is a Canadian singer and songwriter from Toronto who has been making music for more than two decades."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Diverse Heritage
podcast.body: His background is a blend of Caribbean and Mohawk heritage. "His background is part Caribbean and part Mohawk."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
